visualCharacteristics.purpose: product page intro: product image beside the H1, introduction, checklist, call-to-action buttons and a 'Resources + Tools' link table
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; two equal side-by-side columns (image | text) from 900px

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: image (product picture) | text (H1, paragraph, bulleted checklist, button links: bold = primary, italic = secondary, then a bold-only paragraph label such as 'Resources + Tools' followed by a bulleted list of links)

reuseGuidance: Use for the top intro of a product page. The resources table is detected as a bold-only paragraph immediately followed by a list whose items are all links; any other list renders as a checklist.
